worldcombat.skill.firepledge.summary: Raise a pillar of fire and leave a Fire Pledge seal. Combine with a nearby allied Grass Pledge to create a burning sea of fire, or with Water Pledge to create a rainbow that heals allies. Combining consumes the participating seal.
worldcombat.skill.firepledge.description: The pillar erupts at the chosen point and deals %1$s special damage once to each enemy inside, up to %2$s enemies.

The column has a radius of %1$s blocks and is %2$s blocks tall, rising from the real ground below the point and stopping at the contact face when it meets a block above; enemies caught in it are set burning for %3$s, losing about 1/16 of their max health (at least 1) every 5 seconds and dealing half physical damage while burning (targets immune to burning, such as Fire types, are unaffected).
Leaves a Fire Pledge seal at the impact point, %1$s blocks wide in radius for %2$s. Other Pledge moves can combine with it.

If an allied, not-yet-combined grass or water pledge scar lies within %1$s blocks with an unobstructed path to the point, the two vows resonate: this strike deals x%2$s, the participating scar is consumed, and the same scar widens on the spot into a sea of fire (fire + grass, burning enemies inside) or raises a rainbow (fire + water, healing allies who stand in it, with a real arc crown). The resonance field is about %3$s times the scar's radius and lasts about 1.6 times as long; when a combined field already lies near the point, no old scar is reused to amplify again.
worldcombat.skill.firepledge.fierce.on: Fierce vow: power ×1.12, a thicker column, cooldown +12, but the scar's resonance window lasts only 70% as long.
worldcombat.skill.firepledge.fierce.off: Slow vow: power ×0.96, scar resonance window ×1.25, shorter cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.firepledge.timing: Cast range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.firepledge.use.0: Raise a fire pillar on distant ground
worldcombat.skill.firepledge.use.1: Mark ground with a short scar that can resonate
worldcombat.skill.firepledge.use.2: Combine with a grass or water pledge into a sea of fire or a rainbow
On (fierce vow): power ×1.12, a thicker column, cooldown +12, but the scar's resonance window lasts only 70% as long — burns harder, waits less. Off (slow vow): power ×0.96, scar ×1.25, shorter cooldown — less damage, but a longer window for another pledge to resonate.
The companion only raises a fire pillar while the threat is within this distance; beyond it, it closes in first. Lower for close work, higher to light fires from afar.
worldcombat.skill.firepledge.growth.0: From level %1$s the pillar gains another step with level (about %2$s).
